# Known-inert (instrument, seed param) pairs -- see seed_param_liveness_test.go.
# Regenerate: go test -run TestSeedParamsAreLive -v ./internal/audio/ 2>&1 | grep DEADPARAM | sed "s/.*DEADPARAM //"
# The five converted kicks inherit drive_enabled + gen1_gain from the SHARED
# kickStageBase(); the source==5 voice reads neither. They are baselined rather
# than removed because that base is shared with the already-shipped modular
# kicks, whose goldens would move if it changed.
# POST-stage gates (post_enabled / post_decay_rate / post_*_on / post_order) on
# the converted drums read as inert because the macro stage is an exact no-op at
# identity — that is the POINT of the identity. They must NOT be removed: without
# them post_pitch / post_decay / post_drive are dead knobs, which is the exact
# regression TestSynthSavePersists caught on 2026-09-20.
# Dormant HARMONIC DECAY: kick-deep and kick-acoustic-heavy set their 2nd-harmonic
# level (h2) to 0 in the 2026-10-02 fullness retune, so gen1_kick_env1 (that
# harmonic's decay) moves nothing. It is kept at a musical value so raising h2 in
# the Synth tab gives a sane decay instead of an instant one.
# out_clamp=0 (Phase C, 2026-10-03) on the voices that had post_enabled=1: they never had the
# ±1.5 output limit. Inert at default (no default render reaches 1.5) but live on a loud
# edit — removing it would make those edits clip where they never did.
